title: AWS, Cloud & Cloud-Native Architecture
intro: AWS interviews test whether you can pick the right managed service and wire it to a Spring app. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the core services (EC2, VPC, the primitives), then containers (ECS/Fargate — the modern deploy unit), then S3, IAM, and RDS (the services every backend touches). Messaging (SNS/SQS/Kinesis) and serverless (Lambda) follow at the applied tier, then the comparison canon and scenario-based architecture questions.
